fact_text: Fauji Fertilizer's share price gains were the main driver of the index rise, with the stock adding about 12,000 index points in an earlier rally in July 2025.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 18 July 2025 | LCI Stock Split | FFC Lead PSX Surge | KSE 100 Market Update' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The KSE-100 is described as having climbed from about 46,000 points to about 137,000 points, a move in which heavyweight fertilizer and bank stocks played a large part.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 18 July 2025 | LCI Stock Split | FFC Lead PSX Surge | KSE 100 Market Update' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The analyst said profit-taking in the market is healthy, and that banks also contributed heavily to the index's rise.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 18 July 2025 | LCI Stock Split | FFC Lead PSX Surge | KSE 100 Market Update' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The analyst linked Fauji Fertilizer's price rise partly to its stake in Askari Bank, since the bank's own share price has also climbed.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 18 July 2025 | LCI Stock Split | FFC Lead PSX Surge | KSE 100 Market Update' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The analyst noted Askari Bank traded below 1 times price-to-book on 17 Jul 2025, a valuation point he tied to Fauji Fertilizer's rally.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 18 July 2025 | LCI Stock Split | FFC Lead PSX Surge | KSE 100 Market Update' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The analyst's earlier estimate for Fauji Fertilizer's half-year dividend was Rs 8 to Rs 11 per share, since the company's results follow the calendar year.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 18 July 2025 | LCI Stock Split | FFC Lead PSX Surge | KSE 100 Market Update' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The analyst expected Engro Fertilizer's half-year dividend to be about Rs 4 per share.

fact_text: Fatima Fertilizer began paying dividends twice a year, and the analyst noted it trades at roughly 6 to 7 times earnings.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 18 July 2025 | LCI Stock Split | FFC Lead PSX Surge | KSE 100 Market Update' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: A major shareholder holds about 45% of Agritech, and directors from Fauji Fertilizer and Maple Leaf sit on its board, which the analyst treated as a relevant link.

fact_text: Lucky Core Industries is splitting its shares, cutting face value from Rs 10 to Rs 2 (five for one), with post-split trading expected from 21 Jul 2025 at about Rs 356 from a pre-split price near Rs 1,780.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 18 July 2025 | LCI Stock Split | FFC Lead PSX Surge | KSE 100 Market Update' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: As of 18 Jul 2025, Pakistan has about $23 billion of external loan repayments to settle, of which about $11 billion is owed to multilateral agencies.

fact_text: On 18 Jul 2025 the analyst cited total foreign exchange reserves of about $14 billion against the roughly $23 billion of external repayments.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 18 July 2025 | LCI Stock Split | FFC Lead PSX Surge | KSE 100 Market Update' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: Oil and gas companies stuck in the circular debt chain, which have received only partial payments, could become the focus once the market corrects, the analyst said.

fact_text: The analyst expects PSO to gain importance as analysts base their FY26 earnings-per-share estimates on the circular debt and payment situation.
